chunk_text: Should the 11th lord be in the 11th itself or be in an angle or in a trine from the ascendant, there will be many gains. Similarly if the 11th lord is exalted, though in combustion, there will be many gains.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 20 - EFFECTS OF THE 11th HOUSE

chunk_text: If the 11th lord is in the 2nd while the 2nd lord is in angle (from the ascendant) along with Jupiter, the gains will be great.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 20 - EFFECTS OF THE 11th HOUSE

chunk_text: If the 11th lord is in the 3rd while the 11th is occupied by a benefic, the native will gain 2000 Nishkas in his 36th year.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 20 - EFFECTS OF THE 11th HOUSE
meta_configurations_json: [{"name": "Dhana Yoga", "components": ["11th lord in 3rd house", "benefic planet in 11th house"]}]

chunk_text: If the 11th lord is conjunct a benefic in an angle or in a trine (from the ascendant), the native will acquire 500 Nishkas in his 40th year.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 20 - EFFECTS OF THE 11th HOUSE

chunk_text: The native will own 6000 Nishkas if the 11th is occupied by Jupiter while the 2nd and 9th are respectively taken over by the Moon and Venus by position.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 20 - EFFECTS OF THE 11th HOUSE
meta_configurations_json: [{"name": "Dhana Yoga", "components": ["Jupiter in 11th house", "Moon in 2nd house", "Venus in 9th house"]}]

chunk_text: Should Jupiter, Mercury and the Moon be in the 11th from the 11th (i.e. 9th from the ascendant) the native will be endowed with wealth, grains, fortunes, diamonds, ornaments etc.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 20 - EFFECTS OF THE 11th HOUSE

chunk_text: One will gain 1000 Nishkas in his 33rd year if the 11th lord is in the ascendant and the ascendant lord is in the 11th.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 20 - EFFECTS OF THE 11th HOUSE

chunk_text: If the 11th lord is in the 2nd as the 2nd lord is in the 11th, one will amass abundant fortunes after marriage.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 20 - EFFECTS OF THE 11th HOUSE

chunk_text: If the 11th lord is in the 3rd as the 3rd lord is in the 11th, one will gain wealth through co-born and be endowed with excellent ornaments.
meta_source_ref: BPHS1, Chapter 20 - EFFECTS OF THE 11th HOUSE
